name: poes-enforce
description: Pi package that enforces Proof-Oriented Event Sourcing: steers aggregate generation, validates every aggregate you write, and drives a repair loop until the proof passes.
comment: Root pi-package manifest so `pi install git:github.com/kurrent-io/poes` finds the poes-enforce package that lives under .pi/extensions/poes-enforce/. Not a Node/JS build — the project itself is Python (see pyproject.toml).
